Photo Albums 1.1.0

This minor release adds optional, separately stored photo attribution metadata.
The new photo_albums.photo_credits relation leaves every 1.0.0 row and public
endpoint compatible while providing a stable persistence contract for future
credit editing and rendering.

Existing 1.0.0 installations are adopted by exact package digest and observed
schema, then upgraded through the atomic add-photo-credit migration. Fresh
installs record the same migration lineage and apply the same named constraints.
